Title: Vihaan and the Family

Cast

1. Vihaan - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Meenakshi - 36 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Meera - 12 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
4. Pihu - 13 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
5. Rishabh - 8 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Vihaan is asleep in bed in the bedroom. Meenakshi and Meera stand near him.]

Meera: "What lovely weather!"

[Vihaan wakes up and rubs his eyes.]

Vihaan: "What next?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Night

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Vihaan: "Let's begin."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Meenakshi (happily): "What next?"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Meenakshi: "What a day to remember!"
